en: Overload
zh-Hans: 过载
Context: Offer card name of Transform.Storm (reforging.md Text).

en: Shock stacks. At the limit the enemy discharges a chain bolt into those nearby, and a kill on a Shocked enemy does too.
zh-Hans: 感电可以叠加。叠满时敌人放电，连锁到附近敌人；击杀感电的敌人同样放电。
Context: Transform.Storm rules. No number: the catalog may change it.

en: Kiln
zh-Hans: 窑炉
Context: Offer card name of Transform.Forge (reforging.md Text).

en: Enemies that die Burning become slag husks that cleave anything near them.
zh-Hans: 灼烧中死去的敌人变成熔渣残骸，横斩身边的一切。
Context: Transform.Forge rules. No number: the catalog may change it.

en: Glacier
zh-Hans: 冰川
Context: Offer card name of Transform.Tide (reforging.md Text).

en: Frozen enemies become ice pillars that block enemies and their shots, then shatter into Chill.
zh-Hans: 被冻结的敌人变成冰柱，挡住敌人和敌方弹幕，随后碎裂并施加冰缓。
Context: Transform.Tide rules. No number: the catalog may change it.

en: Collection
zh-Hans: 收账
Context: Offer card name of Transform.Shade (reforging.md Text).

en: Marked enemies that die rise as Shades that orbit you and fire your first weapon.
zh-Hans: 被标记的敌人死后化为亡影，环绕你，用你的第一把武器射击。
Context: Transform.Shade rules. No number: the catalog may change it.

en: Zenith
zh-Hans: 天顶
Context: Offer card name of Transform.Radiance (reforging.md Text).

en: Charged shots split into charged lances, and every overkill bursts in light.
zh-Hans: 蓄能弹分裂成蓄能光矛，每次多余的伤害都会炸成光。
Context: Transform.Radiance rules. No number: the catalog may change it.

en: Slipstream Drive
zh-Hans: 滑流
Context: Offer card name of Transform.Quicksilver (reforging.md Text).

en: One more dash charge. Dashes fire all weapons, and your power keeps rising with speed, without a cap.
zh-Hans: 冲刺次数增加。冲刺时发射所有武器，速度越快威力越强，没有上限。
Context: Transform.Quicksilver rules. No number: the catalog may change it.

en: Railstorm
zh-Hans: 轨暴
Context: Offer card name of Evolve.PulseRifle (reforging.md Text).

en: Bolts become orbiting blades that launch at the nearest enemy and return.
zh-Hans: 弹体变成环绕你的刀刃，射向最近的敌人后返回。
Context: Evolve.PulseRifle rules. No number: the catalog may change it.

en: Flechette
zh-Hans: 箭霰
Context: Offer card name of Evolve.ScatterCannon (reforging.md Text).

en: Pellets embed in enemies, then explode.
zh-Hans: 弹丸钉入敌人，随后爆炸。
Context: Evolve.ScatterCannon rules. No number: the catalog may change it.

en: Blade Halo
zh-Hans: 刃环
Context: Offer card name of Evolve.OrbitalDrones (reforging.md Text).

en: Drones become blades that cut what they touch. Their orbit widens the faster you move.
zh-Hans: 浮游炮变成刀刃，切开触及的一切。移动越快，轨道越宽。
Context: Evolve.OrbitalDrones rules. No number: the catalog may change it.

en: Sweep Beam
zh-Hans: 横扫光束
Context: Offer card name of Evolve.RailLance (reforging.md Text).

en: Fires a beam that sweeps across the densest side.
zh-Hans: 发射光束，扫过敌人最密集的一侧。
Context: Evolve.RailLance rules. No number: the catalog may change it.

en: Carpet
zh-Hans: 地毯轰炸
Context: Offer card name of Evolve.FlakMortar (reforging.md Text).

en: Each shell lands as a line of blasts walking forward.
zh-Hans: 每发炮弹落地后变成一排向前推进的爆炸。
Context: Evolve.FlakMortar rules. No number: the catalog may change it.

en: Cyclone
zh-Hans: 旋风
Context: Offer card name of Evolve.ArcBlade (reforging.md Text).

en: Spins in a full circle while you move. Standing still it stops.
zh-Hans: 移动时转成整圈。站定时停转。
Context: Evolve.ArcBlade rules. No number: the catalog may change it.

en: Murmuration
zh-Hans: 椋鸟群
Context: Offer card name of Evolve.SeekerSwarm (reforging.md Text).

en: Missiles stay as a hunting swarm and pick a new target after each hit.
zh-Hans: 导弹留下来成群猎杀，每次命中后另选目标。
Context: Evolve.SeekerSwarm rules. No number: the catalog may change it.

en: Pulse Wall
zh-Hans: 脉冲墙
Context: Offer card name of Evolve.RingEmitter (reforging.md Text).

en: Rings hold as a wall, pushing enemies out.
zh-Hans: 光环化作一道墙，把敌人推开。
Context: Evolve.RingEmitter rules. No number: the catalog may change it.

en: Vortex
zh-Hans: 涡流
Context: Offer card name of Evolve.SpiralProjector (reforging.md Text).

en: The spiral curls inward into a vortex that pulls enemies together.
zh-Hans: 螺旋向内卷成漩涡，把敌人拉到一起。
Context: Evolve.SpiralProjector rules. No number: the catalog may change it.

en: Singularity
zh-Hans: 奇点
Context: Offer card name of Evolve.GravityMine (reforging.md Text).

en: All your mines merge into one that pulls everything in, then collapses.
zh-Hans: 所有引力雷合成一颗，吸入一切，然后坍缩。
Context: Evolve.GravityMine rules. No number: the catalog may change it.
